title: Penguin Solutions to Participate in Rosenblatt's 6th Annual Technology Summit
summary: Penguin Solutions, Inc . (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that the company will participate in the following investor conference: Rosenblatt's 6th Annual Technology Summit – August 17-18. Mark Seamans, Senior Vice President, Global Marketing, will participate in a virtual fireside chat on Monday, August 17 at 12:00 p.m. PT. An event webcast will be accessible on the investor relations section of the Penguin Solutions website at https://ir.penguinsolutions.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx and archived on the site for a period of 30 days. About Penguin Solutions Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG ) is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.
